notes: Cemu (Wii U): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of Cemu. Binary bin/cemu: the 2.6-4 build has bin/cemu and bin/Cemu (hard links), newer builds only bin/cemu (HW 2026-10-06). Cemu finds share/Cemu from /proc/self/exe = <mount>/bin/cemu (sharun execs in userland).

Catalog channel nightly (user decision 2026-10-07): v2.6, the last release, predates Cemu's AArch64 recompiler (#1556, May 2025) and dies with SIGILL in recompiled code; retroforge-emu installs pkgforge-dev's current nightly as nightly-<commit>, checked against GitHub's sha256 digest. HW-tested build: nightly-cc6fea125 (Pocket FIT, 2026-10-06).

-f before -g (boost's implicit value); -g starts the game with no game list. ROMs: .wua (best: game, update and DLC in one), .wud/.wux (need disc keys in ~/bios/keys.txt), or an extracted game's code/<name>.rpx.

Wii U titles never quit and Cemu has no pad menu or pad stop shortcut: OpenGamepadUI's Exit (SIGTERM) or Guide+Start (gamepad_profile, below) is the way out; Cemu handles SIGTERM with an immediate _Exit(0), no dialog (games write their saves themselves).
gui_args: Cemu's own window and game list (touch screen; Cemu has no pad-driven UI).

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for R2 toggle fast-forward and Start Exit application — as keyboard F3/F4, bound in the seeded settings.xml <Hotkeys>; no L1/R1 (no save states). Exit application closes the main window without a veto, Cemu's normal quit (the hotkey is nightly-only, since Cemu 07371327f, 2025-12-26: not in v2.6). Cemu runs keyboard hotkeys on key release.
